title: Apollo Lunar Module
adaptations: Normalized to a 6.8 m visual height and centered; materials tuned for the scene lighting, meshes batched by material, ascent/descent split inferred visually for educational animation. This is a general lunar module model, not a surveyed reconstruction of Eagle.
terrain: NASA LROC DEM retained. Local procedural grain and scattered small rocks are decorative scene dressing, not surveyed objects.
